d:
After 13 long years, Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) is finally arriving on November 19, 2026, and the entire gaming world is waiting!
But what makes GTA 6 one of the biggest entertainment events in the world? Why are millions of gamers eagerly waiting for its release? And how is Rockstar Games preparing to turn a video game into a billion-dollar global phenomenon?
In this special explainer, we take a deep dive into GTA 6, exploring everything you need to know about the highly anticipated game.
